stem: Batch A has 72 rooted cuttings out of 80 at day 14. Batch B has 69 rooted cuttings out of 75 at day 14. Which comparison is correct?
choices: Batch A is better because 72 is greater than 69
Batch A is 90% rooted and Batch B is 92% rooted, so Batch B has the higher normalized rooting rate
Rooting rates cannot be compared when batch sizes differ
rationale: Normalized rates allow comparison across different batch sizes: 72/80 = 90%, while 69/75 = 92%.
